01 / THE CAMPAIGN

SUPPORTING
AUTOMATED TRADERS.

VPS Reimbursement helps eligible STARTRADER clients offset the cost of third-party virtual private server services used in automated trading. The Vietnam relaunch aimed to turn a technical benefit into a clear, accessible customer journey.

EA & automated tradingClient retentionBenefit awarenessVietnam localization

The program is an ongoing benefit. This case study focuses on the Vietnam marketing relaunch, not the original program creation.

02 / THE OFFER

TWO TIERS.
ONE CLEAR BENEFIT.

A reimbursement structure tied to eligible deposits and trading notional volume — communicated consistently across marketing and client-facing materials.

TIER 01

USD 20 / 30-day cycle

Minimum deposit
≥ USD 3,000
Minimum notional volume
USD 500,000
TIER 02

USD 30 / 30-day cycle

Minimum deposit
≥ USD 5,000
Minimum notional volume
USD 1,000,000

Eligibility is assessed over each applicable 30-day VPS billing cycle. Only qualifying closed trades held for at least 5 minutes count. Reimbursement is subject to invoice submission and official terms. Figures represent program rules, not campaign performance.

01

Activate VPS

Use an eligible third-party VPS service; the billing cycle starts from the activation date shown on the invoice.

02

Meet the criteria

Fulfil the relevant deposit and trading-volume requirements within the same 30-day cycle.

03

Submit invoice

Upload the VPS invoice through the Client Portal within three months after the billing period ends.

04

Receive credit

After eligibility verification, the reimbursement is credited to the trading account according to the official schedule.

03 / PERSONAL OWNERSHIP

ONE PROJECT PIC.
END-TO-END COORDINATION.

I served as the project PIC for the Vietnam relaunch, managing local planning, deliverables and cross-functional alignment. My ownership covered coordination and marketing execution — not the company's reimbursement approval decisions.

01 / STRATEGY & CONTROL

IMC Plan & Project Checklist

Built and managed the local integrated marketing plan, tracked deliverables and dependencies, and kept the relaunch workflow organized.

02 / CROSS-REGIONAL DELIVERY

Global Resource Alignment

Coordinated with Global teams to clarify resources, requirements, timing and ownership for client-facing deliverables.

03 / DIGITAL EXPERIENCE

T&C & Landing Page Updates

Coordinated updates to the promotion terms, Vietnamese landing page and opt-in messaging to reflect the confirmed program mechanics.

04 / CAMPAIGN COMMUNICATION

Content Plan & Promotion

Planned campaign messaging and coordinated the promotional rollout across relevant local marketing channels.

05 / SALES ENABLEMENT

Sales Support Materials

Prepared and coordinated practical benefit explanations and campaign materials for the local Sales team.

06 / DELIVERY MANAGEMENT

Follow-ups & Quality Checks

Followed up on outstanding updates and checked that customer-facing communication stayed aligned with the approved requirements.

04 / EXECUTION JOURNEY

FROM REQUIREMENTS
TO MARKET.

A structured workflow connecting Global resources, Vietnamese content and digital client touchpoints.

PHASE 01

Define & Plan

Reviewed mechanics, structured the IMC plan and checklist, identified target segments and confirmed required assets.

PHASE 02

Align & Prepare

Worked with Global teams on T&C, landing page, opt-in, design resources and localized campaign content.

PHASE 03

Launch & Promote

Coordinated promotional content and supporting materials for social, email, website and Sales touchpoints.

PHASE 04

Track & Improve

Monitored deliverable status, gathered feedback and followed up on content and operational adjustments.

The rollout phases describe the project workflow. They are not a claim that every planned campaign asset or phase has already been completed.
